subject: Confidential: interim coverage plan for ACME strategic account
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ACME - proposed interim coverage (sensitive)

Hi Irene / Laura,

Quick note — ACME flagged an urgent escalation on Friday around SLA reporting and a sensitive exec-level request tied to their upcoming board review. Their current account manager is being temporarily reassigned for personal leave starting 12/21, and we need an interim lead in place before next week.

My proposal: assign Vivek as interim GTM lead for ACME (customer-facing only) for the first two weeks while I coordinate technical coverage with CS. Vivek, you'll be the single escalation contact for the ACME execs; Monica/CSEs will handle day-to-day ops.

I attached a confidential checklist and a short summary of outstanding action items. This is sensitive — please do not forward outside the participants listed.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: acme-confidential-transition-checklist.xlsx]
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACME - proposed interim coverage (sensitive)

Vivek — this is time-sensitive and needs executive sign-off for a temporary manager swap. I support Monica's proposal but need you to confirm capacity and explicitly accept the escalation role. Laura, can People Ops help with any required paperwork (NDA/visibility) and make sure the interim assignment doesn't affect ongoing performance review windows?

Actions:
- Vivek to confirm by EOD 12/15
- Laura to confirm any HR notifications required and whether a short addendum is needed to the employee's file
- Monica to provide a 48-hour handoff doc to ACME leads

I will loop in legal only if ACME asks to sign anything new; keep us notified if they request access to our internal incident logs.

Irene Choi
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acmecorp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-legal@acmecorp.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACME - proposed interim coverage (sensitive)

Monica — thank you for the heads up. We appreciate the quick contingency planning. From ACME's side, we only require that the interim lead be briefed on the pending SLA variance and the board report items (attached). No new contract is necessary unless Redwood requests anything broad.

Please proceed with the handoff and let me know who the escalation contact will be by Thurs COB.

Best,
Maria Lopez
Head of IT Operations, Acme Corp
[Attachment: ACME_board_report_items.pdf]
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACME - proposed interim coverage (sensitive)

Confirmed — I accept interim escalation ownership for ACME from 12/21–01/03. I reviewed Monica's checklist and added notes in the shared Drive. Key points I've noted:
- Immediate: authorize weekly exec sync and one-off access to incident logs for the ACME biz review (Laura, advise on any audit steps)
- Ops: Monica to lead the 48-hour technical handoff with ACME SREs; I'll join the first call
- HR: Laura, please confirm whether we need a brief internal memo to the team and a temporary assignment record in Workday.

I've attached the signed internal acknowledgement and a redacted summary of the outstanding SLA items. I'll notify ACME and copy Irene once HR confirms the minor admin steps.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales (cover) — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: acme-nda-scan.pdf]
